fields.issued: Issued 1:30 PM EDT Wed Oct 21 2026 by Kowalski, NWS Wilmington OH
fields.bottomLine: A line of severe thunderstorms will cross Haldane County between 3 PM and 8 PM today. Damaging winds and a few tornadoes are the primary threats.

timeline.event: First storms enter the west end of the county
Line reaches Milford and Cedar Ridge
Storms exit the east end of the county

impacts: Damaging winds to 70 mph: trees and power lines down, outages likely
A few tornadoes possible, with little warning time
fields.confidence: High confidence in timing. Medium confidence in tornado potential; a watch is likely.

decisionPoints.decision: Whether to open the shelter at the fairgrounds
Whether to pre-position crews for debris clearing

fields.nextBriefing: Next briefing 4:00 PM on the partner call; the duty phone is in the partner directory.
